cells.gaps: No share or count with a denominator of local offices making the digital entry: the registrar's 68 of 68 conservatories are 'digitised' (equipped) and leave out the posts below them, and the newest fact (MOZ-006, 2026-08-28) publishes no figure. Facts disagree on deaths (MOZ-004 and MOZ-033 give B and D; MOZ-016, 2025, names death registration as a challenge) and on how the record is made (MOZ-034 has district offices entering directly; MOZ-035 has 534 community points on paper forms keyed at the district office, which no fact calls rural, so no rural gap is flagged); MOZ-001 does not say the new maternity posts enter digitally.
cells.note: Births are registered in a live system past its pilot, entered directly at district offices (MOZ-034), but the only office share is of offices equipped, which places at stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of local offices on a share or count of offices doing the entry.
